types.name: Academic Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are an academic with research or academic work experience, and visiting New Zealand to take part in teaching, education, professional management or research.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 months on this visa.

types.name: Arts and Music Festival Visitor Visa
types.purpose: If you are a performer or support crew you can apply to visit New Zealand to take part in an arts or music festival. You must be invited by an approved arts or music festival.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 months on this visa.

types.name: Escort of Medical Patients Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to escort a patient coming to New Zealand for medical treatment or consultation. You must be needed because of the patient's condition.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: German Law Student Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are a German law student or law graduate and you want to visit New Zealand as an unpaid observer in a New Zealand law firm.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: Group Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are applying as a group who will be arriving in and visiting New Zealand together for the same purpose. One person must submit and pay for the group application with a completed Visitor Visa application for each group member.
types.note: Stay of up to 1 month on this visa.

types.name: Medical Treatment Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to visit New Zealand for medical treatment or consultation. You must be able to pay for your treatment, unless it is funded under a special arrangement.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: New Zealand Electronic Travel Authority (NZeTA)
types.purpose: Some people can use an NZeTA to travel to New Zealand without applying for a visa first. This depends on your passport, how you are travelling and if you are visiting or only transiting.
types.note: Not a visa. Visits of up to 3 months (6 months for UK citizens), at most 6 months in any 12-month period.

types.name: Occupational Registration Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you want to come to New Zealand to get your New Zealand occupational registration. You can also apply if you are already in New Zealand, have applied for residence, and need more time to obtain your occupational registration.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 months on this visa.

types.name: Pitcairn Islander Visitor Visa
types.purpose: If you are a Pitcairn Islander, you can visit New Zealand on this visa. You will need enough money to support yourself while you are here and for your return travel.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: Private Yacht or Plane Visitor Visa
types.purpose: You can travel in and out of New Zealand on a private plane or yacht for up to 6 months on this visa.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 months on this visa.

types.name: Short-term Entertainment Act Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are a performer or support crew member travelling to New Zealand for a live entertainment act. The act must be promoted by an approved promoter.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 months on this visa.

types.name: Sports Events Visitor Visa
types.purpose: This visa lets you visit New Zealand for a sports event or tour if you are a sports person, a support staff member, a match or tournament official, or a media or broadcasting worker.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 months on this visa.

types.name: Super Yachts Visitor Visa
types.purpose: This visa is for owners and crew of super yachts travelling to New Zealand. It allows you to stay or travel in and out of New Zealand for up to 6 months.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: Temporary Retirement Visitor Visa
types.purpose: If you are aged 66 or older and have NZD $750,000 to invest in New Zealand, this visa lets you stay in New Zealand for up to 2 years.
types.note: Stay of up to 2 years on this visa.

types.name: Tour Escort Visitor Visa
types.purpose: You can come to New Zealand as a tour escort with this visa. You must have a letter from your employer confirming your role as a tour escort before you apply.
types.note: Stay of up to 9 months on this visa.

types.name: Visa Waiver Visitor Visa
types.purpose: If you are eligible for a New Zealand Travel Authority (NZeTA) you may be able to travel to New Zealand without a visa. If given entry permission, we give you a Visa Waiver Visitor Visa when you arrive.
types.note: Given on arrival to NZeTA holders: up to 3 months (6 months for UK citizens).

types.name: Visiting Media Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are taking part in Tourism New Zealand's Visiting Media Programme.
types.note: Stay of up to 1 month on this visa.

types.name: Visitor Visa
types.purpose: People travelling on a passport from some countries must apply for a Visitor Visa to visit New Zealand. You can stay for up to either 6 months or 9 months. You cannot work, but you can study for up to 3 months.
types.note: Up to 6 or 9 months per visit, and at most 9 months in any 18-month period.

types.name: APEC Business Travel Card to visit New Zealand
types.purpose: If you have an APEC Business Travel Card (ABTC), you can visit New Zealand for up to 3 months at a time to carry out trade and investment activities. New Zealand needs to be listed on your card as an economy that has pre-cleared you for short-term business travel here.

types.name: Active Investor Plus Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to live, work and invest in New Zealand. You must have at least NZD $5 million to apply under the Growth category or at least NZD $10 million to apply under the Balanced category.

types.name: Business Investor Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you want to invest in and operate a business in New Zealand. You must invest at least NZD $1 million in an established business.
types.note: Stay of up to 4 years on this visa.

types.name: Business Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you want to visit New Zealand for business reasons. You must have enough money to live on while you are here or have the financial support of your employer.
types.note: Up to 3 months in 1 year.

types.name: Entrepreneur Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you want to work in your own business in New Zealand. You must have NZD $100,000 to invest, a business plan, and be able to claim 120 points on our points scale.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Antarctic Traveller Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply to transit through New Zealand to work in Antarctica for a Contracting Party as part of a scientific programme or expedition under the Antarctic Treaty.
types.note: Stay of up to 1 year on this visa.

types.name: Transit Visa
types.purpose: If you are passing through Auckland International Airport you must have a Transit Visa unless you already have a valid visa, are from a visa waiver country or transit visa waiver country, or are travelling to or from Australia.
types.note: You must stay in the transit area of Auckland Airport, at most 24 hours.

types.name: Dependent Child Student Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to bring your dependent children to study at primary or secondary school in New Zealand. You must have an appropriate work or student visa.

types.name: English Language Student Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to study an English language course full-time in New Zealand. You will need to pay the full cost of your courses and enrol with an approved education provider.
types.note: Stay of up to 4 years on this visa.

types.name: Exchange Student Visa
types.purpose: If you have been accepted into an approved student exchange scheme and are outside New Zealand, you can apply for this visa to study full-time in New Zealand.
types.note: Stay of up to 4 years on this visa.

types.name: Fee Paying Student Visa
types.purpose: This visa is for students who are paying international tuition fees themselves, or with support from family, a loan, or a partial scholarship. You must have an offer of place from an approved education provider.
types.note: Stay of up to 4 years on this visa.

types.name: Foreign Government Supported Student Visa
types.purpose: If you have a foreign government scholarship, you can apply for this visa to study full-time in New Zealand for more than 3 months.
types.note: Stay of up to 4 years on this visa.

types.name: NZ Government Scholarship Student Visa
types.purpose: If you are funded by a New Zealand scholarship administered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (MFAT) or Education New Zealand (ENZ), you can apply to study full-time on this visa.
types.note: Stay of up to 4 years on this visa.

types.name: Partner of a Student Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to work in New Zealand if your partner is studying for an eligible level 7 or 8 qualification, or a level 9 or 10 qualification on the New Zealand Qualifications and Credentials Framework (NZQCF).

types.name: Partner of an NZ Scholarship Student Work Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows you to work in New Zealand while your partner is here on an MFAT-funded NZ Scholarship.

types.name: Pathway Student Visa
types.purpose: You can study up to 3 courses, 1 after the other, on this visa. You must have a Pathway Student Visa offer of place and the funds to pay for your tuition fees and living costs.
types.note: Stay of up to 5 years on this visa.

types.name: Student and Trainee Work Visa
types.purpose: This visa is for students or trainees wanting to get practical work experience in their field. This can include, but is not limited to, religious trainees, dental or medical trainees and apprentice jockeys.

types.name: Trafficking Child Victim Student Visa
types.purpose: A child may be given this visa if they are 17 or younger, in New Zealand, and certified by the New Zealand Police as a suspected victim of people trafficking. This visa allows the child to study as a domestic student at primary or secondary school.
types.note: Stay of up to 1 year on this visa.

types.name: Vocational Trainee Student Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are a trainee who has been awarded a New Zealand Short Term Training Scholarship by Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships, or you are a nautical student.

types.name: Accredited Employer Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you have a job offer from an Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV) accredited employer. The employer must send you a link to the online application form.
types.note: Stay of up to 5 years on this visa.

types.name: Child of a Worker Visitor Visa
types.purpose: If you have a work visa, you can apply for this visa so your dependent children can visit you in New Zealand and study for up to 3 months.

types.name: China Skilled Workers Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you have a job offer for a role on the China skilled job list. You must be a citizen of the People's Republic of China and meet the listed requirements.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: China Special Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you have a job offer as a qualified chef, traditional medicine practitioner, Mandarin teacher's aide, Wushu martial arts coach, or Chinese tourism specialist. You must be a citizen of the People's Republic of China.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Crew joining a Ship or Plane Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are a crew member travelling to New Zealand to join a ship or plane leaving for another country, and you do not have a Crew ETA.
types.note: Stay of up to 28 days on this visa.

types.name: Dismissed Worker Visitor Visa
types.purpose: If you have a current work visa and you were dismissed from your job during a trial period, this visa lets you stay in New Zealand for up to 3 months. You cannot work on this visa.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 months on this visa.

types.name: Domestic Staff of a Diplomat Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are a domestic worker for diplomatic, consular or official staff posted in New Zealand. Your employer and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade must support your application.

types.name: Entertainers Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you want to work on a film, video or production in New Zealand and you have specific skills that cannot be met by New Zealand's entertainment industry.

types.name: Fishing Crew Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to work as crew on a fishing vessel in New Zealand waters.

types.name: Global Workforce Seasonal Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you work in a job on the Global Workforce Seasonal Visa job list. You must be asked to apply by an Accredited Employer Work Visa (AEWV) accredited employer.

types.name: Indonesia Special Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are a citizen of Indonesia and you have a job offer as a trained chef, Halal slaughterer or Bahasa teacher's aide.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Japanese Interpreters Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you have a full-time job offer to work as a qualified interpreter in a tourism-related industry in New Zealand. You must be from Japan.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Long Term Skill Shortage List Work Visa
types.purpose: This visa is now closed. You can only apply for this visa if you have already held a Long Term Skill Shortage List Work Visa and you are waiting for a decision on your resident visa application.
types.note: Stay of up to 30 months on this visa. Closed to new applicants.

types.name: Migrant Exploitation Protection Work Visa
types.purpose: If you have reported exploitation while on an employer-supported work visa, this visa will allow you to leave your job while the exploitation is being investigated.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: Partner of Military Work Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows you to work in New Zealand while your partner is here on a military visa.

types.name: Partner of a New Zealander Work Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows you to work in New Zealand if you have a partner who is a New Zealand citizen or has a resident visa.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Partner of a Worker Visitor Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows you to join your partner while they are in New Zealand on a work visa.

types.name: Partner of a Worker Work Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows you to work in New Zealand while your partner is here on a work visa. Your partner must have an eligible work visa to support your application.

types.name: Peak Seasonal Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you work in a job on the Peak Seasonal Visa job list. Your employer must send you a link to the online application form.

types.name: Philippines Special Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are a registered nurse, farm manager or engineering professional from the Philippines. You must have a job offer, qualifications and experience.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Post-Study Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you want to work in New Zealand soon after you have completed your studies here. It allows you to stay and work in New Zealand for up to 3 years, depending on what you studied.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Primary Sector Trainees Work Visa
types.purpose: People from Chile and South Korea can do vocational study and take up work placements in primary sector industries in New Zealand. To apply, you must be supported or funded by your government and intend to return home after your training to share your new skills.
types.note: Stay of up to 1 year on this visa.

types.name: Recognised Seasonal Employer Limited Visa
types.purpose: On the Recognised Seasonal Employer Limited Visa you can come to New Zealand for a short time to work in our horticulture and viticulture industries. You must have a job offer from a Recognised Seasonal Employer before you apply.
types.note: Stay of up to 7 months on this visa.

types.name: Religious Worker Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you have an offer of religious work from a religious organisation.
types.note: Stay of up to 2 years on this visa.

types.name: Republic of Korea Special Work Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you are a citizen of the Republic of Korea and qualified to work in a Republic of Korea Special Work occupation.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Short-Term Graduate Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you want to work in New Zealand soon after completing your studies here and you are not eligible for a Post-Study Work Visa. It lets you stay and work in New Zealand for up to 6 months while you look for a job and explore longer-term work options.

types.name: Singapore Work Exchange Programme Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you want to holiday, study and work in New Zealand. You must be aged 18 to 30 and a citizen of Singapore.
types.note: Stay of up to 1 year on this visa.

types.name: South Island Contribution Work Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you have an Essential Skills Work Visa and have been employed in the South Island for over 5 years. This visa provides a path to residence if you remain in the same industry and region.
types.note: Stay of up to 30 months on this visa.

types.name: Specific Purpose Work Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows you work in New Zealand for a specific purpose or event.

types.name: Supplementary Seasonal Employment Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are already in New Zealand on a student or visitor visa and you want to do seasonal work in the horticulture or viticulture industry.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: Talent (Accredited Employer) Work Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this resident visa if you have been on a Talent (Accredited Employer) Work Visa and have worked for an accredited employer for more than 2 years.
types.note: Stay of up to 30 months on this visa.

types.name: Talent (Arts, Culture, Sports) Work Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you have an exceptional talent in a field of art, sport or culture.

types.name: Thai Chefs Work Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you are a citizen of Thailand, have an offer of full-time work as a Thai chef, and the necessary qualifications and experience to do that work.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Trafficking Victim Work Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you are in New Zealand and certified by the New Zealand Police as a suspected victim of people trafficking.
types.note: Stay of up to 1 year on this visa.

types.name: Victims of Family Violence Work Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you have experienced family violence and have been in a partnership with a New Zealand citizen or resident, or hold a partnership-based visa with a temporary migrant.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: Vietnam Special Work Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you are a citizen of Vietnam and have been offered work in New Zealand as a chef or engineering professional. You must be qualified to do the job you have been offered.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Work Exchange Scheme Work Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to work in New Zealand as part of an approved work exchange scheme.
types.note: Stay of up to 1 year on this visa.

types.name: Working Holiday visas
types.purpose: Holiday and work for young people (usually 18–30, 35 for some) from 44 partner countries: Argentina, Austria, Belgium, Brazil, Canada, Chile, China, Croatia, Czech, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Hong Kong SAR, Hungary, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Korea, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malaysia, Malta, Mexico, Netherlands, Norway, Peru, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, USA, United Kingdom, Uruguay, Vietnam.
types.maxValidity: Usually 12 months (23 months for the UK, Canada and some others)
types.note: Each partner country has its own working holiday visa with its own rules; check the one for your passport.

types.name: Adoption Pre-citizenship Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Children adopted from other countries can visit before their New Zealand citizenship is confirmed. You must provide their birth certificate and evidence that an adoptive parent is a New Zealand citizen.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: Adoption Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Children can come to New Zealand to be adopted by New Zealand citizens or residents. The adoption must have the support of Oranga Tamariki — Ministry for Children.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: Child of Military Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Your dependent children can join you while you are in New Zealand for military work. They can study for up to 3 months and travel in New Zealand while you are here.

types.name: Child of a New Zealander Visitor Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows your dependent children to visit you in New Zealand for up to 9 months. You must be a New Zealand citizen or resident.
types.note: Stay of up to 9 months on this visa.

types.name: Child of a Student Visitor Visa
types.purpose: Your dependent children can visit you while you study in New Zealand. They can study for up 3 months. Dependent children must be aged 19 or younger.

types.name: Culturally Arranged Marriage Visitor Visa
types.purpose: If you have recently married a New Zealand citizen or resident in a traditional arranged marriage, or want to marry in New Zealand, you can get a 3-month visitor visa to begin living with your partner.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 months on this visa.

types.name: Guardian Visitor Visa
types.purpose: If you are a parent or legal guardian of a child who has a current New Zealand student visa, you can apply for this visa to live with and care for your child.

types.name: Parent Boost Visitor Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you have children who are New Zealand citizens or residents. It allows you to travel in and out of New Zealand to visit your family.
types.note: Stay of up to 5 years on this visa.

types.name: Parent and Grandparent Visitor Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you have children or grandchildren who are New Zealand citizens or residents. It allows you to travel in and out of New Zealand to visit your family.
types.note: Stay of up to 6 months on this visa.

types.name: Partner of Military Visitor Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows you to join your partner in New Zealand if they are here on a military visa.

types.name: Partner of a New Zealander Visitor Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows you to visit New Zealand if you have a partner who is a New Zealand citizen or resident.
types.note: Stay of up to 3 years on this visa.

types.name: Partner of a Student Visitor Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows you to visit New Zealand if you have a partner who is studying here.

types.name: Trafficking Child Victim Visitor Visa
types.purpose: A child may be given this visa if they are 17 or younger, in New Zealand, and certified by the New Zealand Police as a suspected victim of people trafficking.
types.note: Stay of up to 1 year on this visa.

types.name: Australian Resident Visa
types.purpose: If you are an Australian citizen or permanent resident you can visit, work and live in New Zealand. You can only apply for this visa when you arrive in New Zealand. If you are an Australian permanent resident, you will need an NZeTA.

types.name: Business Investor Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you hold a Business Investor Work Visa and have been actively running a business in New Zealand for at least 12 months or 3 years, depending on how much you have invested.

types.name: Care Workforce Work to Residence Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this resident visa if you currently have a job or job offer from an accredited employer and have worked in New Zealand for 24 months in a selected care workforce job.

types.name: Community Sponsored Refugee Resident Visa
types.purpose: This visa is for refugees who have been nominated or matched with an approved community organisation (sponsor) under the Community Organisation Refugee Sponsorship (CORS) Programme.

types.name: Dependent Child Resident Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to bring your dependent children to live with you in New Zealand. You must be a New Zealand citizen or resident.

types.name: Employees of Relocating Business Resident Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you are a key employee of a business relocating to New Zealand and you are not eligible for any other resident visa.

types.name: Entrepreneur Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you have been self-employed in New Zealand at least 6 months, or have operated a self-employed business for 2 years on another visa.

types.name: Global Impact Permanent Residence Visa
types.purpose: If you have had a Global Impact Work Visa for 30 months or more, you can apply for this residence visa to live in New Zealand permanently.

types.name: Intercountry Adoption Resident Visa
types.purpose: If you are a New Zealand citizen or resident, you can apply for this visa to bring an adopted child to live with you in New Zealand indefinitely.

types.name: Long Term Skill Shortage List Resident Visa
types.purpose: If you have a Long Term Skill Shortage List Work Visa and have worked in New Zealand for more than 2 years, you may be able to apply for this resident visa.

types.name: Pacific Access Category Resident Visa
types.purpose: If you are from Fiji, Kiribati, Tonga or Tuvalu you can register for this ballot to come to New Zealand. If we select and accept your registration, we invite you to apply for the Pacific Access Category Resident Visa.

types.name: Parent Resident Visa
types.purpose: This visa allows for a parent, grandparent or legal guardian of a New Zealand citizen or resident to live in New Zealand.

types.name: Parent Retirement Resident Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you want to live in New Zealand permanently and you have an adult child who is a New Zealand citizen or resident. You must meet our income and investment requirements.

types.name: Partner of a New Zealander Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can live in New Zealand on this visa if you have a partner who is a New Zealand citizen or resident.

types.name: Permanent Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you have had a resident visa for more than 2 years. This visa lets you live in New Zealand permanently, and travel in and out of the country.

types.name: Pitcairn Islander Resident Visa
types.purpose: If you are a Pitcairn Islander who has been offered skilled employment in New Zealand, you can apply for this resident visa.

types.name: Refugee Family Support Resident Visa
types.purpose: To apply for this visa, you must be sponsored by a family member who came to New Zealand as a refugee or protected person.

types.name: Religious Worker Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for residence if you have had a Religious Worker Work Visa for 3 years. You must have an offer of ongoing work and sponsorship from your religious organisation.

types.name: Samoan Quota Resident Visa
types.purpose: If you are a Samoan citizen, you can register for this ballot to come to New Zealand. If we select and accept your registration, we invite you to apply for the Samoan Quota Resident Visa.

types.name: Second or Subsequent Resident Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you had a New Zealand resident visa that has expired. Your eligibility will depend on the length of time since your visa expired and your commitment to New Zealand before that.

types.name: Skilled Migrant Category Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can submit an expression of interest (EOI) if you have a job or job offer from an accredited employer, and meet the requirements for one of the Skilled Migrant Category (SMC) pathways.

types.name: South Island Contribution Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for New Zealand residence if you have a South Island Contribution Work Visa, and have been employed in the same industry and region for the last 2 years.

types.name: Straight to Residence Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you have a job or job offer with an accredited employer, and your job is on Tier 1 of the Green List of in-demand jobs.

types.name: Talent (Accredited Employer) Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this resident visa if you have been on a Talent (Accredited Employer) Work Visa and have worked for an accredited employer for more than 2 years.

types.name: Talent (Arts, Culture, Sports) Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for New Zealand residency if you have a Talent (Arts, Culture, Sports) Work Visa and have been actively involved in New Zealand in your field for more than 2 years.

types.name: Trafficking Victim Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you are in New Zealand and already have a trafficking victim work, student or visitor visa.

types.name: Transport Work to Residence Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this resident visa if you currently have a job or job offer with an accredited employer, and have worked in New Zealand for 24 months in an approved transport job.

types.name: Victims of Family Violence Resident Visa
types.purpose: You can apply for this visa if you have experienced family violence and have been in a partnership with a New Zealand citizen or resident. It allows you to live and work in New Zealand permanently.

types.name: Work to Residence Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa if you currently have a job or job offer with an accredited employer, and have worked in New Zealand for 24 months in a Green List Tier 2 job that meets our requirements.

types.name: Interim Visa
types.purpose: This visa is normally given automatically to allow you to stay in New Zealand if your visa expires while we are assessing your application for another temporary visa.

types.name: Limited Visa
types.purpose: Apply for this visa to visit New Zealand temporarily for an express purpose. Once you have achieved your purpose, you must leave New Zealand or apply for another Limited Visa.

types.name: Refugee Claimant Visitor Visa
types.purpose: If you are in New Zealand and have applied for refugee or protection status, this visa lets you stay here while we process your refugee or protected person claim.
